insights.name: Insights

about.title: About Insights
about.description:
Insights is a feature that provides you with useful information about your hardware and system. It helps you to understand the current state of your system and make better decisions.
The Insight feature uses 1 to 2 MB of storage per month. 
We recommend that the n-insight feature be enabled unless there are capacity or other issues.

needRestart.title: Restart Required
needRestart.description: You need to restart the app to apply the changes.

insights.resetDescription: This will delete all the data collected by the Insights feature. This action cannot be undone.
insights.scheduledDataDeletionButton: Delete Data Older Than Retention Period

holdingPeriod.title: Retention Period (Days)
holdingPeriod.description: Data collected by Insights is kept for the configured retention period. When deletion is enabled, data older than the retention period is removed automatically at startup.

retention.title: Storage Health History Holding Period (Days)
retention.description: Storage health records are stored separately from Insight data. Records older than this period are deleted automatically.
